reviews.text: Very professional, exceptional service, and most importantly, a love for animals; emergency service, good price.
It's always a good idea to bring your pets here, you're wonderful veterinarians ❤️
Excellent as always

Open weekends and holidays
Very friendly, fast, and reasonably priced service

Highly professional, excellent treatment of pets and their owners. From experience, I can say that this is the BEST veterinary clinic, in terms of care and prices. Thank you for the care you always show Lola and Malu; you will always be my doctors.
Congratulations to the whole team, best regards.
Gus is very grateful for the service

The reality is that the experience can depend almost entirely on the veterinarian you see, which is why reviews can vary considerably for that simple reason.

I mention this because I find it incredible that, despite not being a bad place overall and having prices that I don't consider exorbitant (but rather normal, reasonable, or even good depending on who you ask; I couldn't say for sure), there are some terrible reviews against it. Therefore, I wanted to share my personal opinion: the veterinarian who treats my two cats is one of the best I could ask for, considering the price, location, accessibility, and everything else.

We don't all have our best days, and even so, it's clear that, despite being a bit curt on occasion, he still treats my kittens wonderfully. At least, that's the impression I get.

One of the best veterinary clinics in Madrid, if not the best. Unfortunately, our trusted vet passed away, and we spent years going from clinic to clinic, each one worse than the last. Luckily, we moved across the street and went there one day for an emergency. The service is incredibly professional, and the prices are very reasonable and affordable for all treatments and follow-ups. They won't greet you at the door as if you were bringing in a puppy, but they are efficient, expert, and above all, honest, which is what we value most. They have been our trusted clinic for years, and we believe they always will be. Thank you so much for your work.

I've taken my dog ​​to the vet several times because of bleeding when she defecated. However, the vet told me it's normal, that dogs often bleed when they defecate.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE TAKE THEIR PET THERE. (Unless you want to be told everything is fine when it isn't.)
Top-notch professionals, they are excellent veterinarians. Highly recommended. They saved my dog ​​from two strokes; I couldn't be more grateful.
Very professional and fast
Good service, price and quality

Without a doubt, the best clinic, with the best professionals. They offer 24-hour emergency care and are open for regular consultations on Saturdays and Sundays. No appointment is necessary; you just arrive and they see you by taking your turn. It doesn't matter which one you see, they're all wonderful and very reasonable with their prices. They diagnose quickly. I travel 45km just to take my furry friends there; they won't go anywhere else.
Excellent prices and great care for the dogs

For me, they're the best vets. I've always lived next door, and now I travel from Valdemoro to continue seeing them.
They're honest vets (there are fewer and fewer of those these days), and their prices are very reasonable. I've read bad reviews about their treatment of pets, but for me, they're clear and direct, as well as professional. I'm the one who pampers my dogs; from a vet, I need good knowledge and skill in handling animals.
The on-call service is exceptional. I would never change vets.
I should add that Lola, my youngest greyhound, is terrified of the vet and summons incredible strength to try to escape, even biting. I've never left without them seeing her. They've handled her as best they could and always checked everything thoroughly without complaint, and with good results.
I left Madrid and what I miss most is this veterinary clinic. Top-quality, fast, efficient, and affordable service. You can't ask for more, it's excellent.

Our experience with this veterinarian was very negative. They detected our dog's tumor from day one, but did nothing about it. They only gave us pills and charged us for tests, showing neither empathy nor urgency. The tumor kept growing, and no one offered us any options. Furthermore, they took a long time to refer us to a specialized hospital when it was necessary. We didn't feel they prioritized our dog's well-being, and their treatment seemed cold and unprofessional.
They should have a little more dedication to animals.
They attend to you quickly, are friendly and patient with your pet.

Our experience over the years has been excellent. They are very professional, respectful, non-judgmental, and focused on finding solutions. The quality is affordable, and the cleanliness and hygiene of the premises are excellent. Thank you for being there and helping us take care of our little pets! 👍🤗 …

Yesterday I took my puppy to get his microchip implanted, and one of the vets squeezed him so hard that his ears and body were twitching, as if he hated animals. Honestly, it seemed like he didn't want to treat him at all. What I know for sure is that that vet will never touch my puppy again. I don't know his name, but he's an older, bald, and very unpleasant man.

Excellent service, very attentive and professional.
Very reasonable price.

For me, the best vet in the area. They saved my kitten, who was very sick. They detected that he had eaten something, and sure enough, a fantastic operation! He's recovering incredibly well. 👍🏼 Very grateful to them. …

Among the best professionals I've ever seen, they love animals and do their job exceptionally well, prioritizing the animals' health, unlike others who are only interested in making money. I'll definitely be back with my dogs as soon as needed. They're very quick to respond, even though they don't work by appointment. Thank you so much, because there are hardly any places and professionals like you left ❤️
This is the second time I've taken my kitten there, and they diagnosed her immediately. They're very professional, and they do any tests they need done instantly.
Excellent service and optimal results, very grateful.
The service was, as always, magnificent and professional. As soon as they see the animal, they know more or less what's wrong and they never fail. 10 out of 10!
After nine years, I went back because I have pets again. My children and cats thanked them for their explanations about what it means to have pets.
Neighborhood vet, close to home and excellent service
They're my dogs' doctors; it doesn't matter who treats you, they're all excellent. They're always very busy and have been running this clinic for many years. For me, they're the best.
They always treat my furry friend with so much love, I'm very grateful for the attention given and how well they keep me informed and ease my worries about him.

They're great professionals. It's true they're not the most charming, but that's not their job. They saved my cat's life twice, and they perform every test without hesitation. I'm very grateful to them.
The service is always amazing, and Nube loves it, which is reflected in how they treat the animals!! 🤩 …
I took my dog, who was dying from leishmaniasis, and they saved his life in 48 hours. Excellent care! 👌 👍 Thank you for your attention and interest. …

Honestly, this clinic is a 10/10 for me. My dog ​​was sick, and they cured him. Now he's perfectly healthy and doing great. My dog ​​is my life, and I'm so happy to hear when they do the tests and he's okay. It makes me so happy! 🤗 My only minor complaint is that they should have a numbered ticket system so we don't have to announce who's first. It always gets confusing, and we don't know who's next, which is a bit of a hassle. Otherwise, hats off to them! I highly recommend this vet.

TERRIBLE SERVICE. Parking is a nightmare in that area. I went there the other day to buy a box of pills. I told the cashier I had parked badly, and they didn't care. They left me waiting for ages. After waiting, they finally got the cash register next to the counter, and I paid by card in two minutes. Very unhelpful and lacking in empathy. They must not care about those of us who come from other neighborhoods. I'll definitely be going somewhere else.
Hello, good morning. Sorry to bother you, I'm just stopping by to post a flyer for a missing cat, in case you see her around here. Thank you.
Good professionals, they care about your pet.

Yesterday I had to put my kitten to sleep, and if I'd been a little more careless, I wouldn't have even had time to say goodbye. Unfortunately, it's not the first time, but I've always been able to spend a little time with him, but yesterday it was less than two minutes. TWO MINUTES, when other times I've been able to spend up to 15 minutes. That's left me completely distraught. I didn't have time to cuddle him so he'd go peacefully. At least he left with his nails done, since they'd trimmed them the day before. They don't do a bad job, it's just that they're a bit impatient (no offense).

I've taken my dog ​​to this vet several times after years at another one, as I wanted a second opinion, and the change has been an improvement in every way. They've found some pretty serious issues that the other clinic had never mentioned, and the best part is, you can tell they're not just there to make money. They handle emergencies very well, and since you don't need an appointment, if you go early, as I did, they see you super fast. They offer several services, so you don't have to rely on an external specialist coming in another day and paying extra. Highly recommended.
Excellent veterinarians, very professional. They treat our pets very well. We had our dog neutered and everything went perfectly. Their prices are also reasonable.
Truly depressing. I don't know how you can bring your animals to this place.

They don't take appointments, which is actually a good thing since there are 4-5 vets and things move quite quickly.
I love that they're open on weekends, even if it's not an emergency.
I couldn't be happier with the treatment and professionalism of the clinic.
The only reliable, honest, and professional veterinary clinic I know! Thank you so much!

They're good professionals, but they don't take appointments. Going without an appointment has its pros and cons. The good thing is you can go anytime, but the bad thing is that if you go during rush hour, there might be a lot of people ahead of you. It's also good that they're open Sunday mornings, which is useful for emergencies.
Trusted veterinarian for 20 years

I took my cat in to be neutered and they saw him right away without an appointment. They microchipped him and he was done in two hours. They treated him well when they let me in to watch them give him his vaccinations. They were very kind.

They are shameless! And I say that in capital letters, based on a very bad experience a few years ago. My cat died of cancer that I detected myself with a small lump, and they claimed it was nothing and that it was seen at another clinic when it was already incurable. My daughter's friend took her cat to the emergency room a month ago with a broken leg. Initially, they were given two days of antibiotics. They've been taking him all month, and of course, they've been getting paid, with the doctor telling them he's improving, that it's healing, and...surprise! In the latest...mess, they changed the bandage too tightly and put plastic on the wrong area and on the wrong side...??? They had to go to the emergency clinic in San Cristóbal, and the cat had an infection, oozing fluid and pus, and his paw was swollen. Surprise! The break was still there. Removing the bandage was a real struggle, and he had wounds caused by the plastic, which was completely useless. All the vets (it's a veterinary hospital) were shocked and outraged by the botched job, and to top it all off, today they went and asked for a complaint form, and of course, they got excuses. They were given two stapled sheets when the law requires three, the last x-ray, which supposedly showed he was healing well, is missing, and it's all excuses... Now you take them to this clinic. AH!!!! And I hope you don't delete this review like all the others that were there before and now don't appear.
Professionalism, good prices, and friendly service. They have an emergency phone number. No way am I going back to Ciudad de los Ángeles.
They are true professionals at their job; the attention, information, and service were spectacular. I recommend them 100%, and they also have very good prices. 👍😺 …
I don't know how to thank you all for everything you've done for Simba. You're such great professionals, kind and understanding. Without a doubt, this is now our go-to clinic for all our dogs. 🐾❤️ …
It's the worst clinic I've ever been to. They couldn't even draw blood from the little kitten; they had to force it. They broke her paw, and now the poor thing has bad paws because of it.
Excellent veterinarians. My miniature pinscher underwent surgery for tumors and spaying, and she looks fantastic; the scar is almost invisible. Thank you!

I have no words to thank these professionals who fought alongside my family for the life of my beloved pet, who was diagnosed with a tumor. They treated him with great understanding and professionalism. My dear friend became so accustomed to these doctors that, in the last months of his life, his only joy was when I took him to the clinic for his checkups. Juan Carlos, Nacho, and Guillermo treated him with great professionalism in his diagnosis and with much love. After my faithful friend became a regular patient at the clinic, I was able to see not only doctors, but also, and above all, people who are truly caring and who treat animals with great affection. Sadly, my pet is no longer with us, but these professionals did everything possible to prolong his life with appropriate treatment. Thank you so much for your professionalism and for all the care you gave my beloved Topcho.
They are great, good service.

They spayed my cat and everything went very well. With my previous cat, I used to go to the Delicias hospital, now Medivet, and it was awful. Here, I loved everything: the service, the professionalism, they answer calls and questions—you only have to see how many patients they have.
I'll have to spay my other cat soon, and we'll definitely go there.
I've only been once for an emergency with my puppy; if I didn't have a trusted vet, I wouldn't hesitate... Great professionals and very good treatment of our furry friends.
They are very kind, both in their treatment of the public and the animals.
Everything was great, perfect, excellent service both to the staff and the animals, and good prices on vaccines.
Great job, they saved my dog!
Excellent, beyond words.
They have a good eye for diagnosis. They pull them through. They saved two of my animals—a dog and a cat—from the brink of death.

A primary care clinic with exceptional service; they truly love animals, and unlike other clinics where they bill you before you even walk in, they don't have an emergency service. It's the best clinic I've ever been to. It's not near my house, but it's definitely the one I'll go to.
This clinic is great! We took my dog ​​here because we thought he had a misdiagnosis, and we weren't wrong. Thank you for the care; my dog ​​is much better now.

I am so grateful for the work and care of the staff at Begoña Veterinary Clinic. The attention they gave my kitten was exceptional; they treated him immediately for a liver problem. It's so reassuring to know there are wonderful people who help us in these anxious moments because you never know what's going on with our pets. My little one, Armoniquito, as he's called, shows his gratitude by eating and healing every day. Thank you so much to the staff of this wonderful clinic. The prices are also very reasonable. Thank you!

Excellent service! 😍 There are two guys there, and their service is truly impeccable. And the price is great! 👍 They're friendly, very professional, and attentive to detail. They'll definitely always be my Neji's vets! 🤩🤩🤩🤩 I highly recommend them! 💯 A tip: 😜 It tends to be busier in the morning, so if you have the option, go in the afternoon. 😉
Incredible service and professionalism. Highly recommended.

The facilities are great.
As always, the service is fantastic!
Excellent professionals

I wish this place had more visibility. For me, it's one of the best veterinary clinics in all of Madrid, both for the service and the prices, and because the people there truly love animals. They saved my dog's life first, and now they tried to save my cat's. If only I had gone here first and not somewhere else because I was desperate and gave in to temptation, my cat would surely still be alive.
When I arrived, they didn't mention prices or estimates; they just took the cat and told me they would call me back in the afternoon. Even though the cat didn't make it, I'm eternally grateful to them because I know they did everything they could. If you're looking for a veterinarian, don't hesitate; please, go here.

I've known them for almost 37 years, since my parents' dogs were neutered by them. Thank God, he hasn't needed a vet in the 10 years he's had him because of the distance... we get him vaccinated near home, but we don't know what's wrong with my big guy, and I have no doubt that they will take care of him and treat him like true professionals.
Exceptional people
A misdiagnosis almost cost our rabbit her life. If you don't know something, it's easier to be honest from the start. If we hadn't sought a second opinion, we wouldn't have our rabbit at home.

I wish I'd never had to write this… Today marks three weeks since a part of me died. A misdiagnosis caused me to lose my life companion far too soon, and I feel I must share this in his honor.

My dog ​​suffered from frequent bouts of vomiting, sometimes even with blood. I trusted the professionalism of these veterinarians, and at this clinic, they treated him from the beginning and throughout the six months of illness that ultimately took his life.

The treatment he received wasn't correct because the diagnosis wasn't correct either. Yes, they're human and we can all make mistakes, but not so repeatedly over six months, seeing the dog's condition recurring every few weeks. They didn't perform the necessary tests to arrive at a clear diagnosis, and by the time they identified the real problem, it was too late. I kept insisting that it wasn't normal for this to happen every few weeks, and they replied that it was perfectly normal with the disease they initially diagnosed and that there was no other treatment, but that the animal could lead a relatively normal life and that it wasn't anything to worry about.

He finally had a more severe episode that ended his life. Just two days before his death, they were able to run the necessary tests and discovered the problem was something else entirely, yet they continued with the same treatment. Two days later, while he was hospitalized, it happened again, and they weren't even able to warn us in time to say goodbye to our great friend. As soon as we received the call that he had worsened and it was going to be impossible to save him, we arrived in less than 15 minutes. When I arrived, they told me he had just passed away. This clearly demonstrates the lack of empathy and the little care they have for animals. I only hope that what happened to my best friend never happens again. That's why I'm writing this today, in case I can help other dogs who, like him, fill homes with love and happiness.

Rest in peace, my little rascal ❤️‍🩹

After more than six months of misdiagnosis and incorrect treatment, they realized the cause was something entirely different, and it ultimately cost the animal its life.

Furthermore, they brazenly told us to our faces that we had been informed of the diagnosis by their colleague, even though he wasn't even present—a lie, as two people were there the entire time.

Finally, they had the audacity, empathy, and lack of humanity to not notify us with enough advance notice to say goodbye to our beloved companion. We arrived just 15 minutes later, and he was already gone.

Without a doubt, this clinic leaves much to be desired in all its duties, care, and attention.
Excellent in every way.
Great professionals! And fair prices. Delighted to take Jumpy there.

They are excellent professionals. They provide great service, the tests are quick, and they explain the diagnosis perfectly.
Unfortunately, my Gyna was very old and had a terminal illness, but thanks to the doctors, we made her last days good, and when the time came, no matter the hour, they were there.
I will always be grateful to everyone at the clinic and I recommend them without hesitation.

My family and I want to express our deepest gratitude to these amazing professionals. I have no words to thank Guillermo, Javier, Juan Carlos, and Nacho enough. Our 9-year-old dog, Ronny, fractured his lower jaw on two sides, and we came to this clinic in desperation thanks to a recommendation, after having been to another clinic that, in our opinion, didn't inspire any confidence. As soon as we arrived, they got to work immediately, and the very next day they stabilized his jaw with fixators. It's been a very difficult few months, but thanks to them, Ronny has made a fantastic recovery and is back to his normal life. It's a great relief and a huge relief to now have a trusted veterinarian who truly cares about the animals and has such a wonderful, honest, and compassionate nature—the kind of people you find so rare these days.
Once again, thank you, thank you, and thank you to the team, and of course, thank you from Ronny.

Personally, I haven't found a better veterinary clinic than this one. They don't try to charge you and get you to come back; they treat you quickly and professionally. I've taken my dogs here many times, and it's always gone well. The only downside I'd mention is how difficult it is to park in that area; be patient...

Excellent! Our dog Piter was treated by them for glaucoma, and they performed the surgical procedure. Everything went very well, and their prices are more affordable than other places that don't offer the same quality of service. 1000% recommended!
If you truly love your pet, don't bring it here.

Excellent customer service and great treatment of animals. I took my dog ​​there and it went very well. I recommend it if you need a veterinary clinic, and the best part is that you don't have to wait long because there are several veterinarians working there. If I need a vet again, I'll definitely be back.
I like how they treat my little brother.

I've been taking my dogs there for 13 years, and they are true professionals. The service is excellent, the facilities are very clean, and they have all the necessary equipment for any eventuality our pets might have. The consultation fees are reasonable, but the parking is terrible. They have a shop with accessories and food from top brands, and their emergency service works perfectly. 100% RECOMMENDED.
Top-notch professionals. They care more about their patients than charging you a fortune.
It's a place where we've been treated very well, everything is very clean, and the staff are friendly.
They have no interest in animals. Zero professionalism, zero dedication.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for 13 years and it's always been great. Fantastic professionals, no scams or rip-offs (unlike another well-known vet in the area). Today I had my dog ​​Polo vaccinated and Nacho gave him excellent service, with impeccable professionalism and being very, very kind to Polo. Congratulations to the whole team and thank you.

I've been going to them for 8 years, and I'm very happy with the service; they're very professional. However, I can't say the same about their hairdresser; she's making inappropriate comments and is very rude.
Excellent service

I have to thank God for this place and its professionals. I took my cat here on Monday after having her hospitalized for several days in a supposed hospital in South Madrid where they hadn't done anything for her. She hadn't eaten or used the bathroom since Tuesday and was in a lot of pain. I took her to this clinic in the morning, and in the afternoon I took her home. My cat started eating again, using the bathroom, and doing her normal business again. In three days, my cat is back to her old self, although she still needs treatment, but she's much better. I recommend this place 100%. The professionals are very aware of the pain of animals and the pain of their owners.
Very professional from head to toe. I went with my dog ​​Shira, who was very sick with metastasis, and they helped her and treated her very well in her last moments of life.
I've taken all my pets there for 20 years. They tell you everything clearly, directly and without beating around the bush.
A very good experience, this will now be our trusted vet, thank you ☺️
I took my dog ​​Lucky there, the treatment is great from all the veterinarians, plus you can tell that they love animals and are there because of their vocation.

My family and I have known them for many years, and they have always demonstrated great professionalism, successfully caring for our animals. We have a dog and six cats spread across two homes, and their care has been incredibly dedicated, saving their lives whenever they've been sick—and they've always succeeded.

I will never change veterinary clinics, even if, due to transportation issues, there comes a time when I can no longer drive because I live in Leganés.
My name is Yolanda Casas (I use a different name in the review).
Thank you, doctors, for your empathy and professionalism with the animals.
I went for a second opinion and the service was excellent. Highly recommended.
They have no idea what they're doing, I took my rabbit there and it died
Very good professionals
Excellent service from the veterinarian, they answer all your questions and provide good advice.
Super friendly service. Total trustworthiness.
They are very kind to animals. My little Kenza had surgery and she's doing very well—checkups, cleaning, and lots of attention. 🌺❤️ Go without hesitation; they are very well cared for. ✨✨✨✨✨ …
Excellent veterinarians, they are lovely when it comes to caring for the dogs.
Good service and good prices
Excellent service for me and my dog. I had to take him in for a health issue, and the treatment was exceptional and professional. Prices were reasonable.

Great team! They spayed my kitten and it was a complete success. Considering how scared I am, my girl was supervised the whole time. Thanks to the excellent team, we'll definitely be back. Thank you! ☺️
Highly recommended veterinary clinic, very professional and friendly staff.
I have known the staff for years and I have no regrets regarding their treatment of my animals, their knowledge and professionalism.
Best veterinary clinic in Madrid: price and professionalism
Very professional
They neutered my dog ​​and I'm very happy with the service and the value for money.
Excellent service. Very professional. Very nice people and reasonable prices. It's a pleasure dealing with people like that.
Professionalism, good service, friendliness and diligence.
Good veterinarians, good price, and they attend to you quickly.
Good service and above all, affordable
Fast, friendly, and effective service
